defmodule FirmwareOTA.DeviceManager do
  @moduledoc """
  IoT Device Manager for firmware OTA updates.
  Handles device registration, command dispatch, and audit logging.
  """

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @allowed_modules [
    FirmwareOTA.Commands.Reboot,
    FirmwareOTA.Commands.UpdateConfig,
    FirmwareOTA.Commands.DiagReport,
    FirmwareOTA.Commands.FactoryReset,
    FirmwareOTA.Commands.NetworkScan
  ]

  @allowed_functions [:execute, :validate, :rollback]

  defstruct [:device_id, :firmware_version, :audit_log, :command_history]

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(opts) do
    state = %__MODULE__{
      device_id: Keyword.get(opts, :device_id, "unknown"),
      firmware_version: Keyword.get(opts, :firmware_version, "1.0.0"),
      audit_log: [],
      command_history: []
    }
    {:ok, state}
  end

  def dispatch_command(command_payload) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:dispatch, command_payload})
  end

  def get_audit_log do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, :get_audit_log)
  end

  def handle_call({:dispatch, payload}, _from, state) do
    with {:ok, parsed} <- parse_command(payload),
         {:ok, module, function, args} <- resolve_command(parsed),
         :ok <- authorize_command(module, function, state) do
      result = execute_safely(module, function, args)
      new_state = append_audit(state, module, function, args, result)
      {:reply, {:ok, result}, new_state}
    else
      {:error, reason} ->
        new_state = append_audit(state, nil, nil, payload, {:error, reason})
        {:reply, {:error, reason}, new_state}
    end
  end

  def handle_call(:get_audit_log, _from, state) do
    {:reply, {:ok, state.audit_log}, state}
  end

  defp parse_command(%{"module" => mod_str, "function" => func_str, "args" => args})
       when is_binary(mod_str) and is_binary(func_str) and is_list(args) do
    {:ok, %{module_str: mod_str, function_str: func_str, args: args}}
  end

  defp parse_command(_), do: {:error, :invalid_payload}

  defp resolve_command(%{module_str: mod_str, function_str: func_str, args: args}) do
    module = resolve_module(mod_str)
    function = String.to_existing_atom(func_str)
    {:ok, module, function, args}
  rescue
    ArgumentError -> {:error, :invalid_function_name}
  end

  defp resolve_module(module_string) do
    # Normalize the module path for consistent resolution
    normalized = normalize_module_path(module_string)
    String.to_existing_atom("Elixir." <> normalized)
  end

  defp normalize_module_path(path) do
    path
    |> String.split(".")
    |> Enum.map(&String.trim/1)
    |> Enum.reject(&(&1 == ""))
    |> Enum.join(".")
  end

  defp authorize_command(module, function, _state) do
    module_allowed = module in @allowed_modules
    function_allowed = function in @allowed_functions

    if module_allowed and function_allowed do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :unauthorized_command}
    end
  end

  defp execute_safely(module, function, args) do
    try do
      apply(module, function, args)
    rescue
      e -> {:error, Exception.message(e)}
    catch
      :exit, reason -> {:error, {:exit, reason}}
    end
  end

  defp append_audit(state, module, function, args, result) do
    entry = %{
      timestamp: System.system_time(:millisecond),
      module: module,
      function: function,
      args: sanitize_args_for_log(args),
      result: sanitize_result(result),
      device_id: state.device_id
    }

    Logger.info("Audit: #{inspect(entry)}")
    %{state | audit_log: [entry | state.audit_log]}
  end

  defp sanitize_args_for_log(args) when is_list(args) do
    Enum.map(args, fn
      arg when is_binary(arg) and byte_size(arg) > 100 ->
        String.slice(arg, 0, 100) <> "...[truncated]"
      arg -> arg
    end)
  end

  defp sanitize_args_for_log(args), do: args

  defp sanitize_result({:error, msg}) when is_binary(msg) do
    {:error, String.slice(msg, 0, 200)}
  end

  defp sanitize_result(result), do: result
end

defmodule FirmwareOTA.Commands.Reboot do
  def execute, do: {:ok, :rebooting}
  def execute(_opts), do: {:ok, :rebooting}
  def validate(_args), do: :ok
  def rollback(_args), do: {:ok, :rolled_back}
end

defmodule FirmwareOTA.Commands.UpdateConfig do
  def execute(config) when is_map(config), do: {:ok, :config_updated}
  def execute(_), do: {:error, :invalid_config}
  def validate(config), do: {:ok, config}
  def rollback(_), do: {:ok, :config_restored}
end

defmodule FirmwareOTA.Commands.DiagReport do
  def execute, do: {:ok, %{cpu: 45, mem: 62, temp: 38}}
  def execute(_opts), do: {:ok, %{cpu: 45, mem: 62, temp: 38}}
  def validate(_), do: :ok
  def rollback(_), do: :ok
end
